reason_not_selected: The single existing test opens a localhost Bun.serve listener. Mission39 uses an in-memory transport adapter and does not start a server.

Its selection-revoke phase expects the previous review reference and enabled Prepare current data as a new revision control to remain after revocation. Mission39 clears private content and selection and requires an authorized host reopening.
The existing test is one monolithic case also covering report, comparison, conversation and source-navigation behavior; its workspace subsection cannot be selected independently.
stronger_future_regression: Mount the existing caller signature with authorized initial items, without discover, through production workspace and HTTP modules and a transport adapter that starts no listener.
Keep the exact baseline-side removal, section order, agenda note, captured-comment and source-value assertions before revocation.
Lose the response body only after real durable preservation; require explicit retry with identical idempotency key and payload, identical review body and exactly one stored capture.
After confirmed revocation, require no private content, selection or source-bearing control in the DOM, and prove that an already pending authorized response cannot restore them.
Require a new authenticated host opening before a fresh selection can be offered; do not restore an old selection solely because access later returns.
mission39_coverage: first-agenda.test.ts includes real first-use discovery and the durable lost-response/retry, drift, immutable reload and late-response revocation assertions. It does not claim the existing monolithic test was executed or passed.
assertion_policy: No existing assertions were changed, removed, skipped or weakened. This proposal requires an owner-reviewed stronger replacement for the incompatible revocation expectation.
